# getCompatibilitySearchValuesBulk

Traditional API:
- Metadata API `getCompatibilitySearchValuesBulk`

Scope:
- Retrieve values for multiple compatibility properties.

Migration status:
- REST to Sell Metadata `getMultiCompatibilityPropertyValues`.

Notes:
- Prefer the bulk REST method when the UI needs several fitment dimensions together.

Reference basis:
- Traditional API documentation referenced by this package.
